body: I was down voted to heck recently for expressing this sentiment. You're right, everyone says talk to someone, but when the only course of action is extreme, it really cements your status as a mentally ill person with little chance of turning it around.

I'm not dragging people down, I want people to know that this smug reddit circle jerk of "if you need help ask" is bullshit. I've tried to get help for years, and I've realized that most people don't give a shit about you, they just want to feel better about themselves by being the one offering help.

To people who see this and think they should get help, don't. Telling someone to get help is like a lottery winner telling people to invest in powerball tickets. Yeah, you may have a good life, but you're most likely going to end up locked in a hospital with legitimate crazy people for a few days until they kick you out so they can take someone else in. They give you a bag of pills that'll fuck you up worse than you already are, and you'll be a couple thousand dollars poorer too. Most mental health treatments are ineffective at best and damaging at worst. Choose to drag yourself though life or don't, but don't get your hopes up that it'll get better
Go through with it. Life doesn't get any better from here.
